question: Can the first-party Kodak VISION3 250D datasheet provide a reproducible channel-resolved film MTF trace that supports a separately frozen positive-PSF compiler experiment?

source.title: KODAK VISION3 250D Color Negative Film 5207 / 7207 Technical Data

allowed_after_pass: freeze one development/confirmation split for a positive one- versus two-scale Gaussian PSF compiler
compare the compact compiler against the traced response only in the measured 25-65 cycles/mm interval
forbidden: fit any PSF or image operator in this source leaf
claim roll, batch, exposure, process, scanner or stock calibration
treat the MTF trace as colour response, dye-cloud separation or scanner MTF
use photographic outputs, AO6 or preference evidence to alter trace points
extrapolate beyond the traced frequency interval

branch_rule.pass: Open U6.P5J positive-PSF compiler with a preregistered held-frequency confirmation split.
branch_rule.fail: Close this trace without fitting and continue another physical mechanism leaf.

claim_ceiling: Manufacturer-curve source evidence for one typical Kodak VISION3 250D ECN-2/5500K Status-M measurement; not roll, batch, process, scanner, stock-colour or product calibration.
